title: Smartphone-based digital eczema education program for atopic dermatitis in children aged 0–6 years: multicenter randomized parallel-controlled study
core_idea: To evaluate whether a smartphone-based, caregiver-focused educational program (WeChat-based multimedia modules and a dynamic electronic action plan) reduces 12-week relapse rates in children aged 0–6 years with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis compared with conventional outpatient consultation.
tldr: A multicenter, randomized, parallel-controlled trial testing a 12-week WeChat-delivered digital education program for caregivers of children 0–6 with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with the primary goal of reducing 12-week relapse rates and secondary assessment of disease severity and quality of life up to 52 weeks.
